description: A 2HP four-into-one mixer with a knob per input and a master knob, and no CV at all

params.text: Sets the level of the whole mix, 0% fully counter-clockwise to 200% fully clockwise, at 100% in the centre
Sets that input's level in the mix, 0% fully counter-clockwise to 200% fully clockwise, at 100% in the centre

inputs.text: One of the four signals to be mixed; only patched inputs count towards the average

outputs.text: Carries the four inputs at their knob levels, divided by how many are patched, then taken through the master knob

notes: an unpatched input is left out of the count, so removing a cable in averaging mode raises what is left rather than thinning the mix
menu: Mix mode: Averaging mix, Unity mix — divides the total by the number of patched inputs, or leaves it a plain sum; the light by the MIX output is dark for averaging, red for unity
A-amplification, B-amplification, C-amplification, D-amplification: Normal, Inverted — flips the sign of that section's contribution, and lights a small red mark beside its knob
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
